name: Equivalence Queries Complexity
definition: The **Equivalence Queries Complexity** of $\mathcal{H}$ is the minimum worst-case number of equivalence queries needed to identify an unknown target in $\mathcal{H}$, when the learner may propose arbitrary Boolean functions as equivalence hypotheses.
graph_summary: Minimum worst-case number of arbitrary equivalence queries needed to identify the target.
origin_references: Equivalence queries in the exact query-learning model are introduced in \cite{angluin1988queries}.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.

strict_c_monotonic.proof: By definition, strictly monotonic means doubly monotonic and strictly c-monotonic.

strictly_monotonic.proof: By definition, a doubly monotonic strictly c-monotonic parameter is strictly monotonic.

monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly equal to Littlestone Dimension by the established relationship `equivalence_queries_complexity_littlestone_dimension`; its monotonic classification transfers unchanged.

p_monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly equal to Littlestone Dimension by the established relationship `equivalence_queries_complexity_littlestone_dimension`; its p monotonic classification transfers unchanged.

tight_strict_c_monotonic.proof: This parameter is exactly equal to Littlestone Dimension by the established relationship `equivalence_queries_complexity_littlestone_dimension`; its tight strict c monotonic classification transfers unchanged.
